messages:
Yara: Heads-up: during magnet-16b-int8 onboarding I hit a deterministic divergence right after a KV cache wrap and a RoPE multiplier toggle. Prefill=70k, continuation mismatches token-by-token after the wrap.

Miles: Can you share the minimal repro & command?

Yara: run id kv-wrap-rope-70k-2025-06-18
cmd:
```bash
./serve --model magnet-16b-int8 --ctx 140000 --prefill tests/long_70k.txt --rope-mode dynamic --seed 13
```
log snippet:
```text
[00:01:12] prefill OK tokens=70000
[00:02:00] kv-wrap at 65536 applied
[00:02:01] first mismatch @65540 fp16='able' int8='abl\n'
```

Ops Bot: ci job started: longctx-wrap-1827770000 (commit d4f7a1). Artifacts: gs://ci/longctx/1827770000/logs.tgz

Chen: Sounds like an encoding/truncate in the handshake or rotary offset. Is it always around 65536?

Yara: Mostly yes; sometimes at other boundaries (120k) but this run pinned to 65536. I dumped handshake payloads: encoder used uint16 for token_count and wrapped.

Miles: Quick mitigation: clamp rope-mode for quant builds to fixed=1.0 until patch. Also add a CI regression with prefills [65534,65535,65536,66000] to the longcontext suite.

Rhea: I'll add a unit-level test in tests/longcontext/handshake_overflow_test.py and a small property test that encodes/decodes counts across [1..ctx_max] using both varint and fixed32.

Chen: Root fix: change handshake field to 32-bit and validate applied_rot_offset == prefills_total before applying. Also log and fallback to fp16 kernel when mismatch detected. I'll open PR and request canary rollout on dedicated.

Yara: Reproducer script is in tests/repro/kv_rope_wrap_min.py (seeded). Dropped artifacts in the job. Tagging P1 for onboarding regression. Leaving the env ssh://dev-kv-1 if anyone wants to poke. :mag:
